title: Calla and the Star Map
markdown:
Gather 'round, explorers! I've got a tale about Calla and her friend Dr. Ada, a brilliant star-gazer.

One evening, a giant oak tree fell right across Dr. Ada's path! "Oh dear," she sighed. "I'll miss the first stars appearing!" Calla saw the problem. The log was too big to push or climb. Just then, Sprig the mole popped up. "I can dig a tunnel!" he squeaked. But Dr. Ada said, "It would take too long, little friend."

As the sun dipped, tiny lights blinked in the sky. "Look, Calla!" Dr. Ada pointed. "That's the Big Dipper, like a giant spoon! And over there, a flying swan – Cygnus!"

Calla’s eyes grew wide. "They look like pictures!"

"Constellations!" Dr. Ada beamed. "Long ago, explorers used them as maps. The Big Dipper points to the North Star, guiding you anywhere! That way will take us *around* the tree, towards your farm. And Cygnus helps find the way back here!"

Calla felt a little nervous about going off the path. But Dr. Ada was so sure. "Okay!" Calla said bravely. "Let's follow the stars!"

With Sprig leading, Calla and Dr. Ada walked under the night sky. The crickets chirped as they followed their glowing map. Soon, they saw Calla's cozy farmhouse lights, and then Dr. Ada's star-house!

"We did it!" Calla cheered. Dr. Ada hugged her. "The stars are a map, Calla. They helped people find their way for ages."

Calla looked up at the twinkling sky. "I wonder," she whispered, "what other secrets the stars are hiding?" And Dr. Ada knew this was just the start of their starry adventures.
characters: Calla the farm helper, Sprig the mole, Dr. Ada
author: StoryGen Community
